attempts.failure: the complete isolated suite still returned nonzero after the frozen raw copy, but the temporary evidence directory was removed before the builder exception exposed the unittest failure details

attempts.failure: 525 isolated tests produced 11 failures and 20 errors because git archive emitted repository LF blobs instead of the Windows checkout bytes used by frozen SHA guards; representative failures were the Candidate manifest byte mismatch and Week-1 frozen manifest hash mismatch
attempts.resolution: replaced git-archive extraction with a local no-hardlinks git clone plus detached HEAD checkout so working-tree filters reproduce frozen bytes before task overlay; retained the ignored raw dependency copy and isolated PYTHONPATH

attempts.failure: the local clone reproduced the same 525-test 11-failure/20-error result because checkout conversion changed LF object bytes to CRLF; direct comparison proved the Candidate working file and HEAD blob hash were f912798a while Git filtered output had a different hash
attempts.resolution: changed snapshot construction to write every tracked HEAD object via git cat-file blob without checkout filters, then overlay exact current task bytes; this preserves frozen object bytes deterministically

attempts.failure: the first exact-blob builder invocation stopped at Python parse time because the new subprocess.check_output call was missing its closing parenthesis
attempts.resolution: restored the closing parenthesis and reran readiness generation before any verification or packaging occurred

attempts.failure: the 611-test exact-blob suite produced 7 failures and 34 errors because frozen runtime contracts intentionally mix object-byte and checked-out-byte hashes: Candidate manifest requires LF f912798a, while Evidence Gate holdout outputs require current CRLF working bytes 06fe9075 instead of LF blob 84f62c09
attempts.resolution: build the isolated baseline from exact current bytes for every clean tracked path, fall back to HEAD blobs only for unrelated modified paths, then overlay exact EA1 task paths; this preserves runtime frozen hashes without importing user-owned edits
